verdict.rationale: Ramp documents bill upload (drag-and-drop invoices), automatic PO matching and GL coding, dynamic multi-department approval routing, and automated vendor payment (ramp-docs-2, ramp-docs-16, ramp-docs-17), corroborated by a positive hands-on community account of easy approval-to-payment workflows (ramp-comm-2). Missing for 10: independent third-party audit of the full bill-pay approval chain and more granular detail on rejection/exception handling in approvals.
